rules: Declarations, fields, assignments and statements end with ';', also the last one before '}'.
Float literals have digits on both sides of the point (1.0, 0.5, 2.5e-3), never 1. or .5; integer literals have no sign, no leading zeros and no hexadecimal form.
Comparison operators (< <= > >=) and equality operators (== !=) do not chain: write (a < b) && (b < c).
Typed values are never converted implicitly: an i32 value is not an f32 value, and only a literal such as 1 may stand where an f32 is expected.
An import is import { Name } from "./path.mtek"; the path is relative (starts with ./ or ../) and ends in .mtek.
Every scene needs a camera: camera Main { position: vec3(0.0, 2.0, 5.0); }.
Fields and parameters must exist on their schema or declaration: an unknown name is an error, never ignored.

diagnosticsGuide: `mtek check --format json` prints one JSON report; each diagnostic has code, severity, title, message, source (file, startByte, endByte, startLine, startColumn, endLine, endColumn), expected and actual (when relevant), related, notes, suggestedEdits and phase. Fix errors in report order, apply a suggestedEdit only when it is present (they are validated), and never delete the feature a diagnostic is about.
